final:
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= cap
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(2, [10, 20, 30]) == 2
  let (tx, rx) = Channel[int](cap)
  var count = 0
  for x in xs
    tx.try_send(x) else break
    count += 1
  count
